meta.title: Aluvia
meta.description: Coordinación de ayuda después de un desastre: qué casas están afectadas, qué necesita cada una y dónde hace falta gente.

home.title: Coordinating aid, home by home
home.lead: Aluvia shows which homes a disaster affected, what each one needs and where volunteers are needed. It is under construction.

devUi.title: <highlight>Design system</highlight> catalog
devUi.lead: Every piece with its variants. Check them in light and dark, and at 375, 768, 1024 and 1440 px.
devUi.addressHint: Street and number, as you would write it on an envelope.
devUi.phoneError: Check the number: some digits are missing.
devUi.cardBody: Made-up data. Damage on the ground floor, two older adults.
devUi.glassBody: A glass panel floats over the map or the background, never over text.
devUi.selectHint: Native select: the phone opens its own picker.
devUi.formError: It could not be saved. Try again.

notFound.title: We could not find this page

location.missingHelp: Write the address so people can find the home.
location.addressHint: Street and number, as you would write it on an envelope.
location.approximateHelp: The GPS is not sure where you are. Write the address too so people can find the home.
location.locatingHelp: If it takes long, write the address. The GPS joins in on its own when it answers.

needs.title: What does it need?
needs.empty: This emergency has no work types set up yet.

details.vulnerable: Elderly people, children or people with disabilities live here
details.addressHint: Helps people get there if the GPS is off.
details.phoneError: Check the number. If it is from another country, start with + and the code.
details.notifyLabel: Let me know when someone takes the job
details.notifyHint: We only write to you about this home. Reply STOP to stop the messages.
details.notesHint: Anything that helps find the home or come prepared.
details.hazards: Do not enter: there is a risk of
details.hazardsHint: Nobody can take work at this home until a coordinator reviews it.

missing.location: The location or the address is missing.

done.sentBody: Volunteers can see it now. Share the link so help gets there.
done.queuedBody: There is no signal. It will send on its own as soon as it comes back, even if you close the page.
done.shareFailed: We could not share the link. Open it with View the home and copy it from there.

danger.toggle: Someone is in danger right now
danger.callFirst: Call first. Aluvia coordinates cleanup and does not replace emergency services.
danger.callLocal: Call your country's emergency number first. Aluvia coordinates cleanup and does not replace emergency services.
danger.thenContinue: Then you can go on with the report: a coordinator will see it first.

batch.title: Add several homes
batch.lead: Paste the text of a story or a message. Review each home before creating it.
batch.textHint: It is not saved. Any names and phone numbers in it are ignored.

batch.vulnerable: Elderly people, children or people with disabilities live here

batch.forbidden: Only approved coordinators of this emergency can add homes in bulk.
batch.dangerChip: Person in danger: call emergency services

trust.noMoney: Aluvia never asks for money. If someone charges you in its name, it is a scam.

form.title: People and supplies
form.lead: Count who is working now and mark what is missing.
form.suppliesEmpty: This emergency has no supplies set up yet.
form.sentBody: The count is recorded for this home.
form.queuedBody: There is no signal. It will send on its own as soon as it comes back, even if you close the page.
form.signIn: To update this home, sign in with the link your coordinator sent you.

emergencies.title: Emergencies
emergencies.newLead: It is created with its own copy of the disaster type's work template.
emergencies.slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens. It forms the shared link.
emergencies.typeOption: {name} · {count, plural, one {# work type} other {# work types}}
emergencies.localeHint: When a text is missing in the viewer's language, it is shown in this one.
emergencies.startedAtHint: Local time in the chosen time zone.
emergencies.workTypeCount: {count, plural, one {# work type} other {# work types}}
emergencies.settingsLead: Daily message caps and the details shown in notices.
emergencies.reserveLabel: Reserve for neighbors without the app
emergencies.reserveHint: Messages from the cap kept for people who only get SMS or WhatsApp.
emergencies.contactHint: The authority's phone or website. Never a neighbor's.
emergencies.surveyHint: The one the authority uses to record damage.
emergencies.areaHint: A GeoJSON file with the area's polygon. You can add it later.
emergencies.closeLead: Once closed it stops receiving reports and its settings are frozen. This cannot be undone here.
emergencies.noticeLead: Shown above the map and the report. Use it to debunk rumors and announce closures. Never a neighbor's details.
emergencies.numbersHint: Shown first to someone in danger, in the report and on WhatsApp. Official numbers only.
emergencies.membersLead: Approve coordinators and field volunteers, and invite by WhatsApp.

disasterTypes.title: Disaster types
disasterTypes.empty: There are no disaster types yet.
disasterTypes.keyHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and underscores, in English. It never changes.
disasterTypes.templateLead: It is copied into every new emergency of this type. Changing it does not affect existing emergencies.
disasterTypes.supplyTemplateLead: What can be requested for a home (shovels, gloves). It is copied into every new emergency of this type and may stay empty.
disasterTypes.itemKeyHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and underscores, in English.
disasterTypes.templateSummary: {key} · {workTypes, plural, one {# work type} other {# work types}} · {supplyTypes, plural, one {# supply} other {# supplies}}
